launches.title: aSim - build and share your app ideas instantly on your phone
launches.tagline: aSim is a mobile app that lets you generate and share mobile apps instantly. Prompt > Run > Remix > Repeat your way to the next TikTok!
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re the Daniel’s from [aSim](https://asim.sh/).

**tl;dr**

aSim is a mobile app that can generate your app ideas into usable apps in less than 30 seconds. After, generating you can play with your app and decide to remix it, or publish it to your profile to share with your friends. Generations (called Sims) also get access to a plethora of pre-built apis such as LLM calls, image/video generation, native APIs (gyro, location, etc) and even APIs like weather and news.

**We believe building mobile software should be fun, accessible, and serendipitous.**

<https://youtu.be/F0Fk6VLFHAc>

### Some of our favorite Apps from the community so far

Coffee brewing timer: [https://asim.sh/@enoki/s/106799](https://asim.sh/@enoki/s/106799/make-me-a-coffee-timer-for-different-brewing)

Star Wars Fleet Commander Idle-Game: [https://asim.sh/@jojaspero/s/29102](https://asim.sh/@jojaspero/s/29102/star-wars-imperial-fleet-commander)

OpenStreetMaps tag stats explorer: [https://asim.sh/@lake/s/104102](https://asim.sh/@lake/s/104102/osm-stats)

Game to find a DD: [https://asim.sh/@enoki/s/105398](https://asim.sh/@enoki/s/105398/dd-finder)

Twitter, but with historical figures: [https://asim.sh/@shannon/s/43367](https://asim.sh/@shannon/s/43367/twitter-but-historical)

TicTacToe vs AI: [https://asim.sh/@hashmelons/s/105561](https://asim.sh/@hashmelons/s/105561/ai-tic-tac)
